evidence.title: Canberra | CDC Data Centres
evidence.excerpt: CDC's current Canberra location page identifies Beard as its fourth campus in the region, directly calls it currently under construction, and says it will contain the BE1 data centre.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 109984-byte content-decoded official HTML response body captured with curl --compressed
metadata.canonical_url_basis: The requested and effective URLs exactly match the page's absolute rel=canonical URL.
metadata.retrieval_method: One credential-free curl GET with HTTPS redirects, compression, retries disabled, and separate exact response-body, response-header, and curl effective-response-facts captures.
metadata.request_credentials_guardrail: The request supplied no Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, authentication option, client certificate, cookie input, or cookie jar. A response-set cookie was not replayed.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at equals the response HTTP Date in UTC. The evidence-key identifier, snapshot as_of_date, and local research date remain 2026-07-20 in America/Los_Angeles.
metadata.publication_date_guardrail: The live location page exposes no source-verifiable publication date or last-modified date, so published_at remains null.
metadata.locality_scope: The first-party Canberra location page places the named Beard Campus in CDC's Canberra region and its page description identifies Canberra, Australia. This supports broad locality only.
metadata.construction_wording_as_reported: Our fourth data centre campus in the region, Beard, is currently under construction; Currently under construction, this campus will be home to our BE1 data centre.
metadata.physical_threshold_scope: The first-party page's direct present-tense under-construction wording crosses the Atlas physical-build threshold. It is not a permit, proposal, financing, land-control, capacity-contract, or future-intent statement.
metadata.status_scope: The present-tense statement supports one generic project-level under_construction observation on the 2026-07-20 America/Los_Angeles retrieval date. It does not isolate demolition, clearing, earthworks, excavation, foundations, structure, shell, MEP, fit-out, energization, commissioning, completion, occupancy, operation, pause, or cancellation.
metadata.currentness_guardrail: The lifecycle row is a last-observed status on 2026-07-20, not a claim that construction persists after that date. Later releases must refresh or age it rather than silently treating it as current.
metadata.identity_scope: The page identifies one named Canberra campus and BE1 as the data centre the under-construction campus will contain. The normalized project represents that bounded BE1 campus development; it does not create additional buildings, phases, parcels, facilities, or a complete CDC Canberra inventory.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The page does not label 39 MW as critical IT load, gross facility demand, contracted or energized grid connection, generation, current draw, measured consumption, or annual energy. The value remains untyped source metadata and creates no normalized capacity row or conversion.
metadata.role_guardrail: CDC authorship, possessive wording, and portfolio context do not by themselves assign standardized owner, developer, operator, landlord, tenant, customer, user, utility, contractor, or investor roles to Beard or BE1, so roles remain empty.
metadata.operating_model_guardrail: The page does not establish a standardized hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, government, owner-occupied, or wholesale operating model for Beard or BE1.
metadata.workload_guardrail: Page-wide references to customer sectors, density, liquid cooling, government, national critical infrastructure, or technology are portfolio positioning and do not establish BE1's workload, tenant, customer, user, installed hardware, accelerator, or model.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The page supplies no current electrical load, annual energy, measured consumption, PUE, WUE, renewable share, contracted supply, grid capacity, storage, or generation observation. MW is not converted to MWh.
metadata.address_guardrail: The page supplies no street address or parcel identifier for Beard Campus. The normalized address is broad locality text only and is not a postal address.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: No point, parcel, footprint, or geometry is normalized, and no coordinate is inferred from maps, publisher imagery, nearby facilities, satellite imagery, or analyst geolocation.
metadata.site_count_guardrail: The page's fourth-campus wording is regional portfolio context, not a verified present site, parcel, building, phase, or facility count. Only the named Beard campus and its bounded BE1 development are represented.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The statement that Beard will be home to BE1 and that developments are anticipated supplies no completion, ready-for-service, commissioning, energization, occupancy, or operational date.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved company location page; the raw captured response, response headers, cookies, publisher imagery, and other media are not redistributed.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The raw public HTML response, response headers, and curl writeout were moved intact with their explicit temporary directory to the user's Trash after exact validation; they remain recoverable but are not retained in this repository artifact.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No publisher image, aerial image, satellite scene, computer-vision output, or analyst geolocation contributes to identity, lifecycle, locality, capacity, roles, classification, energy, or site count.
